## Changes since `v0.8.0`

### Features

- remember the main window's size, position and maximized state, so a quit, restart or update reopens it where it was left; bounds are taken once the window settles, so a maximize animation no longer overwrites the place it un-maximizes to, and a window left on an unplugged monitor opens centered on the main one ([1cb1d050](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/1cb1d0501fabdf67041405cf7a253cc4b057c2af))
- let the crab look around: its pupils are their own layer, so the full crab glances left and right inside its eyes while both blink together, and the small crab blinks too; a knocking crab's eyes stop with its claws, so a tab waiting on an answer no longer keeps the window drawing frames ([baa41891](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/baa418913a3c64e034ab668b206800d67fd7a274))
- check for updates from the tray menu: it shows the window, opens the update settings and checks the configured channel even when automatic checks are off, and records the check time; a download, install or restart already under way is shown instead of starting another check, and a manual check that joins a silent background check now shows its result or error rather than going back to idle ([6db9aab7](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/6db9aab7ad4f560e7d99748a16445c0ac4e4d75e))
- let openSettingsTab open the settings page at a given section, switching an open settings tab to that section too, while opening it without one keeps the section it was on ([c513a933](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c513a933cc4c91b6d75c07ebfca49525b43f3944))
- reopen the tab closed last with Cmd+Shift+T on macOS (unbound elsewhere, where Ctrl+Shift+T opens a tab) or from the tab bar's menu: a tab of the bar comes back in its place with its split, its pane sizes and the pane that had the focus, every local shell in the directory it was in and every connection connecting again; a pane closed out of a split goes back exactly where it was while that tab is as it was left, else beside the pane it was next to, else as a tab of its own; the last 20 closings are kept for this run only, without the passwords typed for them, and pages and remote files are left out ([ad8cffaf](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/ad8cffaf4f6450231a47f2aac4f29ec55d5ac7a8))
- save local terminals as connections: the connection dialog saves a local terminal with its shell, a start directory (typed or picked, ~ for home), startup commands typed in each time the shell starts, a terminal theme, a highlight set, a logging choice and a group, and lists it in the launcher, the hosts panel and their search; a local tab without a profile can be saved from its menu or with Mod+Shift+O, which opens the dialog filled with its shell, the directory it is in and its name, and edits the saved connection of a tab that has one; a saved tab keeps running in the directory it is in when the profile is saved or edited, and deleting the profile leaves its local tabs open, unsaved; a connection's own terminal theme now applies to every kind of tab, where only SSH tabs used it and a serial profile's theme was ignored ([0d26b365](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/0d26b365fad704d88c273678345c6ddea2afef41))
- let a saved profile be a local terminal, keeping the shell it starts (by kind, path, the user's own shell id or WSL distribution) and the directory it starts in, so a local tab that was set up for a task can be saved and opened there again; a start directory may begin with ~, which is the home directory of the machine it opens on, for local shells and WSL alike, so the same profile works on devices whose home directories differ ([728515cd](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/728515cd92c4be77fd225e05ea66a78126b515d5))

### Fixes

- show each Codex tab its own work again when Codex 0.166's shared server is still the child of the Codex that started it: the hook took the first ancestor with a terminal as its Codex, went past the server to that Codex and wrote every session's reports there unaddressed, so that tab kept spinning for other tabs' turns while theirs showed nothing; the walk now stops at the nearest Codex, and one without a terminal is the server, whose reports go with the session's id to every Codex terminal; the Windows hook stops the same way ([2e56ab86](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/2e56ab86117cdba529b7d60fca20f64a23119586))
- end the settings search when something outside the page asks for a section, as the tray's update check does, so the results no longer cover the section it opened, even when that section was already the one open ([28ad1bc7](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/28ad1bc756a600e27a1c08828eef454fd2dd34f6))
- keep an update check asked for from the tray until the UI takes it, and let the UI listen before the config has loaded and run the check once it has, so a click made while the app is still starting is no longer lost ([aff4c64f](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/aff4c64fb8915d68f89097a3193015360b68e860))
- check the channel asked for when an update check of another channel is already running, by waiting for it to end and then checking again, so a check made just after switching channels no longer reports the old channel's result ([9404b4aa](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/9404b4aab0bfbfd92f66929143ed16bb5e9b9288))
